name: Walton Wharf and its ducks and swans
summary: Walton Wharf on Manor Road, beside The Swan and The Anglers, is a familiar place to watch ducks, swans and other river wildlife year-round, reached via a gentle slope from Manor Road. It has no railings at the water's edge and no public benches or toilets.
reasonToVisit: A well-loved riverside stop for watching swans and ducks beside two pubs
planningDetail: No railings at the water's edge and no public toilets — keep children close to the water
